entries.title: First entry
entries.body:
This is your log book. Type freely here — it's plain text, and blank lines make paragraphs.

Use the checklist below for anything you want to tick off, and tags to group entries (e.g. work, research, personal).

Delete this entry whenever you're ready.

checklist.text: Create the GitHub repo and turn on Pages
Paste a fine-grained token into Settings
